positive_snippets: Location wise it is quite good and rooms are also available for guests. If you are coming here by looking at its location on the map then the location will be wrong. Weddings with small parties, receptions and gatherings are organised quite well here.

I attended a wedding event here. The venue is impressive, and the outdoor dining area is very spacious. Around 400–500 people can comfortably dine at the same time. Overall, a great place for large gatherings.
Spacious party hall for each and  every kind of function with hotel rooms ...
negative_snippets:
Beware: This is an oyo hotel located in Delhi. However, the exact location and name of this hotel listed in oyo's website is WRONG. I had booked this hotel from oyo's website and reached at the location given in that website with my family only to find that there wasn't any hotel at that location. As noone was answering the phone at the hotel reception at that time, I resorted to booking another hotel from another aggregator's website, while browsing on that website I found the correct location of this hotel.
Note: On oyo website it is listed as Hotel O VP Grand located in sector 7, dwarka, New Delhi; whereas this hotel's actual name is Hotel O Vishwakarma Palace located in sector 4, dwarka, New Delhi
